_meta.harness: 60 body-only probes: a sentence drawn from the second half of a document body, discarded if >40% of its distinctive tokens already appear in that document's summary

backfill.note: DB size unchanged to 3 decimal places — 986 vectors is nothing against a 262 MB file. The 80k vectors that chunking the conversation dumps would have added is the number this avoided.

doc_retrieval.why_the_baseline_is_already_high: document_fts indexes the body, so a VERBATIM body query was already reachable lexically. This probe uses verbatim sentences and so measures the smaller half of the gain. The half FTS structurally cannot serve is paraphrase — that is what test_doc_body_semantic_recall covers, and it went from a strict xfail (rank 5 of 5) to passing at rank 1.

memory_search_unaffected.note: identical to baseline; chunks live in their own table and never enter memory retrieval
